description: This file defines the GLToolbox class, providing static methods for loading shaders, creating OpenGL programs, checking for GL errors, and initializing texture parameters in an Android OpenGL ES 2.0 context.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: A utility class for handling OpenGL ES 2.0 shader compilation, program linking, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Compiles a shader of a given type with provided source code, throws an exception if compilation fails.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL program by compiling vertex and fragment shaders and linking them, throws an exception if linking fails.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws an exception if any are found.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes texture parameters for linear filtering and clamp-to-edge wrapping.
